name: Staging QA Tester
tagline: Clicks through your staging build like a real user and grades every feature
description: Before a release it walks your staging site as a real visitor would, one role at a time, grading each feature Pass, Partial, Fail, Blocked or Untested. You get a written report, it restores what it touched, and it never deletes accounts or exposes credentials. The sharer credits it with catching a live privilege bug.
author: njivy
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
